target: 100% of the original Japanese DoCoMo route, spoiler-free and preservation-honest

areas.name: Selected DoCoMo Route and Preservation
areas.location_cue: The Japanese DoCoMo application menu, carrier data, Stories mode, and Situations mode.
areas.note: Separate the complete subscribed release from the preserved public trial before recording progress.

save_backup.title: Clone the handset storage
save_backup.why: Server-delivered scenario data cannot be recovered from an overwritten device.

levels.1: Confirm the carrier build before treating a save as the completion record.
levels.2: The selected route is the Japanese DoCoMo version distributed through the original mobile service.
levels.3: Use a preserved compatible DoCoMo environment containing the full subscribed application and all downloaded scenario data. Record the handset model, application version, and local scenario files before starting.

items.label: Do Not Substitute the Trial Client

levels.1: The surviving public application is not the complete release.
levels.2: The preserved trial contains three offline Situation stages; Stories mode still requests the retired server.
levels.3: At the mode menu, confirm whether Stories opens Scenario 01 without a network error and whether more than the three trial Situations exist. If either check fails, label the environment trial-only and do not claim full completion.

levels.1: This title originally delivered scenarios through a carrier service.
levels.2: Back up the application plus every downloaded Stories-mode data file before play.
levels.3: Create two read-only copies of the full handset storage, hash the application and data files separately, cold-boot one duplicate without network access, and verify that all previously downloaded scenarios remain selectable.

levels.1: A preloaded archive can hide the real point and unlock trail.
levels.2: Begin with no purchased equipment, completed scenario, or extra character marked.
levels.3: Capture the initial Stories list, Situations list, point balance, shop, file index, outfit screen, and character screen. Keep the untouched backup beside milestone saves.

levels.1: A complete subscribed handset would be a rare preservation artifact.
levels.2: Keep two read-only storage images plus complete menu and result captures.
levels.3: Hash the full handset dump, clone it twice, capture every scenario, Situation, shop, file, outfit, and character page, and document the exact hardware and carrier build without redistributing proprietary data.
